action.objective: Push d5-d6 to fix the pawn structure and force Black to spend a tempo capturing, while keeping the rook on d2 active.
action.rationale: d5d6 is the only commit_ready move: verified depth 3 exact score -1076, safety complete (no mate-in-one; tactical_refutation not_found), and it was the reserved broad-search suggestion. The alternative g4g5 carries an upper-bound score, which can hide a much worse outcome. d6 provokes cxd6, opening the c-file for White counterplay.
